from markdown.extensions.toc import run_postprocessors, render_inner_html, striptags
import markdown

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes'])
result = md.convert('# H[^1]\n\n[^1]: f')
print("Result HTML:", result)

# Parse the resulting HTML to check TOC link text
from xml.etree import ElementTree as etree
root = etree.fromstring(result)
# Find the TOC anchor
for a in root.iter('a'):
    if a.get('href', '').startswith('#'):
        print(f"TOC anchor text: {a.text!r}")
        assert a.text == 'H', f"Expected 'H', got {a.text!r}"

# Test run_postprocessors
result_text = run_postprocessors(md, 'test')
print(f"run_postprocessors result: {result_text!r}")

# Test render_inner_html
elem = etree.Element('div')
elem.text = 'hello'
child = etree.SubElement(elem, 'span')
child.text = 'world'
inner = render_inner_html(md, elem)
print(f"render_inner_html result: {inner!r}")

print("m2 verified")
